name: Monarca de las Sombras · Trono del soberano
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE highly detailed standalone apparel print of Sung Jinwoo, the Shadow Monarch from Solo Leveling. Recognizable young adult Korean anime/manhwa protagonist, sharp face, tousled black hair, piercing luminous blue-violet eyes, black outfit. Dense premium manga/manhwa illustration, intricate ink lines, dramatic layered composition, crisp screenprint textures, electric violet and icy cyan highlights with silver-white detail that remains visible on a black shirt. Full artwork inside generous margins, genuine transparent alpha outside the entire illustration. No photographed shirt, no mockup, no interface, no watermark. Avoid a simplistic icon. Typography must be clean and correctly spelled. Composition: regal seated Jinwoo on an elaborate obsidian throne formed from shadow blades, violet spectral crown hovering above, ranks of his shadow army emerging below among gothic arches and dense smoke. Strong centered vertical silhouette, ornate frame integrated with shadows. Exact text only: SOLO LEVELING above and SHADOW MONARCH below.
